focus.description: Free text about what to put first, such as `error tracking` or `billing reports`. A request with focus always builds a new list, and an unfocused request never reuses it.

limit.description: The most reports to return, best first. Defaults to 25. Values above the configured maximum (50) use the maximum.

refresh.description: Build a new list even when the stored one is current. A build calls a model and can take 30 seconds or more.
